title: Sexual Assault and Aggravated Sexual Assault
grade_or_penalty: Aggravated sexual assault: 1st degree. Sexual assault: 2nd degree
key_points: Aggravated: sexual penetration with a victim under 13, or with aggravators such as a weapon, severe injury, during another serious crime, help from others, or a helpless or incapacitated victim.

Sexual assault: penetration using physical force or coercion without severe injury, sexual contact with a child under 13 by an actor at least 4 years older, or penetration with a 13-15 year old by an actor at least 4 years older, among other circumstances.
elements: The suspect committed an act of sexual penetration with the victim

Plus one of the statute's circumstances, for example: physical force or coercion; a victim under 13; a 13-15 year old victim with an actor at least 4 years older; or a helpless or incapacitated victim
For aggravated sexual assault, identify the aggravating circumstance (weapon, severe injury, during another crime, aided by others, etc.)

subsections.label: a(1)
subsections.text: Aggravated: penetration with a victim under 13

subsections.label: a(2)
subsections.text: Aggravated: victim 13-15 and the actor is related, has supervisory or disciplinary power, or is a resource family parent or guardian

subsections.label: a(3)
subsections.text: Aggravated: during robbery, kidnapping, homicide, aggravated assault, burglary, arson or criminal escape

subsections.label: a(4)
subsections.text: Aggravated: armed with a weapon and threatens to use it

subsections.label: a(5)
subsections.text: Aggravated: aided by others and using physical force or coercion

subsections.label: a(6)
subsections.text: Aggravated: physical force or coercion causing severe personal injury

subsections.label: a(7)
subsections.text: Aggravated: victim physically helpless, intellectually or mentally incapacitated, or incapable of consent

subsections.label: b
subsections.text: Sexual contact with a victim under 13 by an actor at least 4 years older

subsections.label: c(1)
subsections.text: Penetration using physical force or coercion, without severe personal injury

subsections.label: c(2)
subsections.text: Victim on probation, parole or detained, and the actor has supervisory or disciplinary power

subsections.label: c(3)
subsections.text: Victim 16-17 and the actor is related, has supervisory or disciplinary power, or is a resource family parent or guardian

subsections.label: c(4)
subsections.text: Victim 13-15 and the actor is at least 4 years older
